title: Cadmus API enum manifest
description: Single definition of every API enum that has a Rust side. Build scripts generate the Rust enums, the protobuf enums, and the mapping code from this file. Locale is not listed here: it is generated from docs/po/*.po.

derives.description: Rust derive list for the generated enum.

attrs.description: Rust attributes placed on the generated enum.

all_doc.description: When present, the generated enum also gets `all() -> &'static [Self]` with this doc.

reserved_numbers.description: Protobuf numbers kept reserved; no active variant may use them.

reserved_names.description: Rust variant names kept reserved; emitted as `{PREFIX}_{SCREAMING_SNAKE}` proto names, and no active variant may use them.

rust.description: Rust variant name (or locale code for proto-only Locale).

number.description: Protobuf number. Append-only and strictly increasing.

type.description: Rust payload type for data-carrying variants.

cfg.description: Cargo cfg predicate guarding the variant.
